CameraAngleSweepTowardActionParam.description: Parameters for CameraAngleSweepTowardAction: closed-loop turn to the current sampling plan target orientation.

rotation_threshold.title: Rotation Threshold
rotation_threshold.description: Maximum allowed angle difference in degrees to treat the player as already facing the target orientation. Defaults to 2.

CameraAngleSweepStepRecognitionParam.description: Parameters for CameraAngleSweepStepRecognition: reports the sampling plan state for loop branching.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: remaining hits while steps remain in the plan; done hits once the plan is exhausted.
